camel_example: aliyun rtc DescribeFaultDiagnosisOverallData --region cn-hangzhou --StatDim JOIN_SLOW_USER --StartTs 1615824000 --AppId '4eah****' --EndTs 1615910399 --version 2018-01-11 --method POST --force
description_en: Retrieves the overview data of exception diagnostics
description_zh: 调用DescribeFaultDiagnosisOverallData获取异常诊断的概览数据
name: DescribeFaultDiagnosisOverallData

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: start_ts

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: end_ts

parameters.help_en:
The statistical dimension. Valid values:
JOIN_SLOW_USER: the number of users who joined the channel slowly
AUDIO_STUCK_USER: the number of users who experienced audio stuttering
VIDEO_STUCK_USER: the number of users who experienced video stuttering
VIDEO_VAGUE_USER: the number of users who experienced blurry video
HIGH_DELAY_USER: the number of users who experienced high call latency
FIRST_FRAME_SLOW_USER: the number of users who experienced slow first screen rendering
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据统计维度。取值：
JOIN_SLOW_USER：进频道慢用户数。
AUDIO_STUCK_USER：音频卡顿用户数。
VIDEO_STUCK_USER：视频卡顿用户数。
VIDEO_VAGUE_USER：视频模糊用户数。
HIGH_DELAY_USER：通话延迟高用户数。
FIRST_FRAME_SLOW_USER：接收首屏慢用户数
parameters.name: stat_dim
